mentions.name: Thingio (payment-unlocked vending cabinet)
mentions.description: A smart vending cabinet styled like a little free library that sells products, originally excess honey from community bee hives. An LTE module connected to a solenoid lock listens for a 'checkout complete' callback from a Stripe payment link to unlock the cabinet, and weight sensing tracks the current product inventory inside. The service has been expanded to be product-agnostic so others can use it.
mentions.problem: Provides a way to sell and distribute excess honey from community bee hives locally in a neighborhood, supporting wellness outreach that combats food deserts through small-scale farming.
mentions.audience: Neighborhood residents buying honey; operated by a family friend doing wellness outreach in the community
mentions.source_excerpt:
A little free library style box, but not free and not a library (https://thingio.dev)

I've got an LTE module connected to a solenoid lock. The module listens for a "checkout complete" callback from a Stripe payment link which will unlock the solenoid. There's also some weight sensing involved to track the current product inventory inside the cabinet.
